mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior three months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 212.5) signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 212.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior three months signals robust labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased >0.5% and UNRATE decreased >0.3pp over the prior three months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market collapse (HOUST < 1000) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior three months signals weakening consumer demand, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has declined over the prior three months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 over the prior three months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior three months indicates a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0 and HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior three months signals strong consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS has increased over the prior three months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
